notes: Only synthetic fixture files created under one TemporaryDirectory; no ROS/WSL/runtime/frozen archive read or modification.
Source45 runner/protocol/fixture function bodies were read from the exact git commit, not reconstructed from current files.
Only path slash normalization and the exact verified new two-token compatibility pair are considered.

common_input_comparison.input: Exact source45 legacy protocol passed independently to source45 and current46 trial_spec

legacy_protocol_differences.current46: New candidate registration only; frozen Humble45 failures and contracts remain unchanged. Actual ROS header source ages retain independent 0.5 s limits and 0.05 s future bounds. Requested RTF only plans bounded host receipt watchdog budgets (0.5/RTF, at most 10 wall seconds); it never converts observed source age. Command expiry or stream silence retains zero-velocity HOLD, while odometry stream loss or source clock regression latches ABORT. A 0.1 s steady watchdog shares the control executor and reuses the normal FOLLOW/HOLD state guards, including unchanged status source/wall/future limits and vehicle state; it publishes one invalid command only when aborting and does not add a second normal control stream or prove independent DDS health. The trial CLI resolves an omitted stream mode from the explicit PX4 timestamp domain: source_sim selects source_sim and receipt selects receipt_wall. Core plans always name the mode; a historical protocol without this registration explicitly requests receipt_wall in the new runner to preserve custom legacy timeout semantics. The node default and real/receipt behavior stay unchanged. Every new plan, resolved argv policy, run_config and actual runtime YAML must bind the actual mode and budgets before fresh development validation; original safety argv remains subject to independent four-slot resolved-runtime verification.

source45_legacy_protocol.scope: New v4 engineering validation; does not replace or repeat the frozen v3 four-estimator study. Historical failures, interruptions and unknown identity intervals remain unchanged.
source45_legacy_protocol.seed_partition_policy: Development has already used seeds 0, 1 and 3. Formal v4 uses previously unexecuted held-out seeds 1000..1009, frozen before formal outcomes; development probes must not consume them. The same registered v4 seed is reused across classes/groups. PX4/Gazebo process seed remains registered_seed+1. Historical v3 paired seeds 0..9 remain a separate four-baseline study, with no paired v3-v4 claim.
source45_legacy_protocol.duration_policy: Prospective task-protocol revision, not an algorithm repair: core and condition-extension FOLLOW both last 75 s, preserving equal-duration paired comparisons. Keep the original +32 s explicit reselection, +/-1 s shutter guards, all REQUEST-to-full-clock UNKNOWN cells, and final-settling gates. Ideal planned events already impose approximately 10.3 s of structurally uncertifiable identity time; an 80% coverage requirement allows only 9 s in 45 s and is therefore unattainable even ideally. At 75 s the same illustrative 80% budget permits 15 s, leaving approximately 4.7 s for confirmation, recorded tails and occasional missed evidence; this is a design budget, not observed coverage or a registered numeric gate. Preserve all historical 45 s/Humble22 results unchanged and do not pool unequal durations as algorithm improvement. Require actual 75 s measurements for all 28 development cells and a new capacity budget before formal execution; never substitute historical 45 s sizes. Numeric navigation requirements are registered separately in navigation_acceptance; overall formal admission still requires complete final-source development readiness, calibration, sealing and a fresh capacity budget. This duration change alone cannot authorize formal execution.
source45_legacy_protocol.simulation_resource_policy: Prospective simulation resource revision simulation_rtf0125_wall1000_adapter50_v2: request RTF 0.125 for both classes and every new core, safety and extension cell, with a fixed 1000 s flight wall budget and explicit 50 Hz source-time PX4 adapter publication. Controller and supervisor loops retain their original 20 Hz source-time cadence; the supervisor heartbeat freshness/prestream gap remains 0.4 s wall time, and native startup remains 180 s wall time. The explicit simulation_pacing_registration and matching top-level values are authoritative. Historical v1 RTF 0.125/1000 s with implicit 20 Hz adapter, legacy RTF 0.25/600 s and RTF 0.50 evidence remain unchanged and cannot qualify this adapter cadence revision. Keep the 75 s source-time task, target physical motion, 10 Hz inference ceiling, fixed 10 Hz physical-identity evaluation grid, source-time freshness/prediction gates and numeric acceptance gates unchanged; post-flight processing and evaluation budgets remain 1800 s each. New same-source development validation, calibration, sealing and actual capacity admission remain required before formal held-out seeds can be used. Record actual wall processing latency, achieved RTF and observed heartbeat wall gaps. This resource change does not establish navigation reliability or real-hardware real-time performance.
source45_legacy_protocol.gazebo_render_policy: Prospective Gazebo-process-only Mesa llvmpipe selection; record actual owned-process rendering libraries/environment. Historical auto/D3D12 trials retain their original renderer and exit failures. No silent auto override or cross-renderer performance pooling.
source45_legacy_protocol.shutter_protocol: Successful close ACK starts the original minimum dwell plus 0.05 s render allowance. A finer scheduler reduces tick quantization; request/ACK intervals are not rendered occlusion truth. This is a changed v4 scheduling protocol, not a retrospective correction of v3.
source45_legacy_protocol.magnetic_library_policy: Freeze the explicit installed-package Gazebo library registration for this ROS/Ubuntu environment, and match each trial's owned-process actual loaded ELF path/hash to it. Humble uses a separate config/gazebo_magnetic_runtime_humble22.json registration. Source-version agreement cannot stand in for matching a different distribution's binary. No runtime self-registration or automatic acceptance of an unexpected ELF.
source45_legacy_protocol.magnetic_environment_policy: Use Gazebo ENU/gauss magnetic output with the pinned isolated PX4 FLU-to-FRD bridge patch. Freeze the verified source/dependency/ELF runtime manifest before a plan is created; verify actual startup log, binary and source binding for every trial. Gazebo and PX4 lookup tables remain different. No target GT or trajectory-fit correction. The historical v3 and coherent_wmm intervention evidence remain unchanged. The manifest does not yet exist until the real isolated build is verified; never fabricate it.

supervisor_status_timing.wall_check_clock: ROS-time control tick; no independent status steady timer

source45_legacy_protocol.source_time_policy: Disable XRCE Agent wall-clock mapping before client startup only for this Gazebo simulation. Independently audit raw PX4, timing diagnostics and source-stamped adapted odometry, keeping callback receipt and recorder delivery distinct and retaining all clock-tail silence. Invalid domains/regressions or a locked vehicle-frame reset fail the trial even when online protection correctly rejects them. Source-clock evaluator PASS is necessary but does not establish navigation performance or flight success. Preserve original bounds and register numeric navigation gates only after development probes, before formal trials.
source45_legacy_protocol.vehicle_uncertainty_policy: Propagate reported PX4 pose covariance into navigation measurement covariance, including attitude uncertainty. This prospective setting remains subject to development probes and does not change the original innovation/safety gates.

multi_target_crossing_profile.policy: One finite quintic lane exchange followed by forward travel in the exchanged lanes. The 18 s duration is the nearest whole second to 17.905 s, matching the previous first sinusoidal exchange's peak lateral speed. Actual paths and separation require independent GT evaluation. Historical Humble13 used periodic sinusoidal exchanges, retains its conservative HOLD/performance failures, and is not pooled or paired with this prospective task revision. All full-interval navigation, physical identity, safety and final-settling gates remain unchanged; this task revision is not an online occlusion-geometry improvement.

source45_legacy_protocol.takeoff_policy: PX4 NAV_TAKEOFF and ARM precede Offboard; startup must observe AUTO_LOITER, final magnetic/yaw alignment, healthy same-instance VLP/odometry and settled pose before REQUEST_OFFBOARD. MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT=3, COM_TAKEOFF_ACT=0 and SENS_IMU_MODE=1 are explicit pre-rcS overrides. An independent recorded-command/mode/readiness native_startup evaluator must pass; online readiness helper replay is not independent evidence. Resets after Offboard locking still hold the mission under the original frame-guard contract.
source45_legacy_protocol.failure_policy: One simulator at a time. A trial is attempted once. Terminal records, failures and interrupted attempts are immutable. Resume consumes only PENDING slots. Infrastructure failures stop continuation and require a separately recorded diagnosis before any further pending slot; they never authorize a retry.
source45_legacy_protocol.identity_policy: Initial middle box selection for multi-target conditions; hybrid_3d association; no nearest/confidence fallback and no full ReID. The acceptance denominator is fixed 10 Hz REQUEST-to-full-recorded-clock time, retaining unknown/unobserved tails. Legacy diagnostic-frame coverage remains diagnostic. Any observed wrong physical actor in either evidence stream fails; an unconfirmed requested task fails. Every task is independently mapped from its REQUEST box at source image time. A schema-v2 development gate must bind immutable probe plans/terminal records and actual reports for all 2 classes x 6 groups, flight-critical source/model/runtime hashes and separately identified offline evaluator hashes.

offline_selected_identity_visibility.policy: Keep the unique image IoU>=0.5 match, fully-in-frame extent, freshness, shutter guards and fixed REQUEST-to-full-clock identity denominator. For positive same-class GT-box overlap only, an additional sufficient certificate requires all three declared actors and complete rigid static render meshes, audited closed-scene assets, exact-source vehicle/actor geometry and exact physical camera/base geometry for a gimbal recording. Every overlapping other actor must have its whole-mesh optical-z minimum strictly greater than the chosen actor's whole-mesh maximum plus 0.05 m. Missing/unsupported geometry, near-plane crossings, multiple feasible image matches or overlapping depth bands remain UNKNOWN. This offline-only rule never chooses an online identity, supplies a runtime measurement, establishes YOLO box completeness, changes the MOT visible subset or removes unknown time cells. Freeze its evaluator and asset provenance before formal outcomes; preserve historical reports and failures.

source45_legacy_protocol.comparison_policy: Report all 120 slots and all failures. Pair v4 classes/groups by the same held-out registered seed 1000..1009 where applicable. Active/midpoint visual improvements do not replace base_link physical following errors. Historical v3 uses paired seeds 0..9 for its separate four-baseline study; these v4 trials are not paired reruns of v3 and do not repeat that estimator comparison.
